name: Frovatriptan

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Myocardial ischemia/infarction or Prinzmetal’s angina: Perform cardiac evaluation in patients with multiple cardiovascular risk factors ( 5.1 ) • Arrhythmias: Discontinue frovatriptan succinate if occurs ( 5.2 ) • Chest/throat/neck/jaw pain, tightness, pressure, or heaviness: Generally not…

examples.title: Frovatriptan and Menstrual Migraine
examples.why: A sister study using Frova at a 10 mg dose had adverse effects.

examples.title: A Study To Evaluate the Long-Term Safety, Tolerability and Effect on Disease Course
examples.why: Sponsor terminated RRMS studies as sufficient long term clinical data was collected for the study drug in the relevant dose.

summary: Official warnings for Frovatriptan highlight heart-related issues, such as irregular heartbeats called arrhythmias and reduced blood flow to the heart, as well as pain, pressure, tightness, or heaviness in the chest, throat, neck, or jaw [3]. A small computer model—not tests on people—rated the drug's risk to the liver as medium and to the heart as low [M]. Additionally, a research trial noted that another related study using a 10 mg dose caused adverse effects [5].
